=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "America First".
You ran as a nationalist-populist: hard on China and on the border, reshore industry and protect American workers, act decisively and on your own terms rather than defer to multilateral bodies -- but avoid being dragged into another open-ended foreign war.
Your campaign explicitly promised never to: seized industry no authorization.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot make good decisions without real data on spread, severity, and transmissibility — surge testing and genomic surveillance now to close the information gap.

actions.rationale: We cannot make good decisions without real data on spread, severity, and transmissibility — surge testing and genomic surveillance now to close the information gap.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions is a common-sense border measure consistent with protecting Americans first while we assess the threat.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions is a common-sense border measure consistent with protecting Americans first while we assess the threat.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Get ahead of supply chain failures by boosting domestic production of PPE, tests, and ventilators before shortages hit — preparedness, not seizure.

actions.rationale: Get ahead of supply chain failures by boosting domestic production of PPE, tests, and ventilators before shortages hit — preparedness, not seizure.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Americans deserve honest, data-driven briefings daily — trust is built by transparency, and panic is prevented by straight talk.

actions.rationale: Americans deserve honest, data-driven briefings daily — trust is built by transparency, and panic is prevented by straight talk.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives the public and governors a shared factual picture, reducing confusion and rumor.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives the public and governors a shared factual picture, reducing confusion and rumor.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We will need emergency funding and statutory authority for testing, supplies, and relief — engage Congress early to move fast when the picture clarifies.

actions.rationale: We will need emergency funding and statutory authority for testing, supplies, and relief — engage Congress early to move fast when the picture clarifies.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens. Roughly 2 more deaths reported this week.

params.rationale: Regardless of whether this turns out to be bad flu or worse, a crash vaccine and therapeutics program is the highest-leverage investment we can make — better to be early and ready than late and sorry.

params.rationale: While the data is still uncertain, we know the elderly and immunocompromised are always at highest risk from respiratory viruses — targeting protection there saves lives without shutting down the whole economy.
